periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the ovoid eye patches are oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle, converging towards the rostrum relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit a teardrop/ovoid morphology with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering is visible, with the inferior margin extending notably below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The transverse dark band is thick, occupying roughly 40% of the visible lateral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely spaced, with the medial gap approximately equivalent to the horizontal width of one pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae are characterized by smooth, semi-circular convex arcs.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow soil-staining or pigmentation is visible on the ventral and posterior white pelage.
